stories.title: The frontier labs launch election war rooms
stories.take: The frontier labs dusted off the old election war-room playbook for the deepfake era — the open question is whether it worked.

stories.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models' identity
stories.take: FlashProve would let anyone verify an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from — provenance as a product feature.

stories.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
stories.take: Grid waits now run years, so builders are powering data centers with discarded jet engines — dirtier and less efficient, but available now.

stories.title: Researchers warned of North Korean hacking tactics years before record $6.3B Binance heist
stories.take: A fake job interview and a malicious download — tactics flagged years ago — still opened the door to a $6.3B theft at the world's largest crypto exchange.

stories.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
stories.take: Fal raised $1.3B led by Bessemer and doubled its valuation in five years — running models, not training them, is where the money is moving.

stories.title: Hiding inside Palantir's skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
stories.take: Palantir's U.S. commercial revenue passed its U.S. government revenue for the first time — a milestone with a warning tucked inside it.

stories.title: Levi's claymation holiday campaign celebrates handmade craft amid AI bloat
stories.take: Levi's is selling hand-made in a feed full of AI slop — a nostalgic bet after a back-to-school campaign that missed its demand target.

stories.title: As Publicis closes LiveRamp deal, some brands say they're jumping ship
stories.take: Liquid Death's media chief says marketers should worry about a holding company owning their data — and some brands are already walking.

stories.title: The Trade Desk Brings Back Dave Pickles Amid Growing Pains
stories.take: The co-founder and former CTO, gone since 2023, returns to lead a CTO Council over the tech roadmap — AI agents included.

stories.title: Respect Over Authenticity: Whalar Group Rewrites the Brand-Creator Partnership
stories.take: Whalar's Neil Waller argues trust, creator ownership and operational discipline — not 'authenticity' — are what reshape the creator economy now.

stories.title: Gap's Holiday Choir Tradition Reaches New Heights With Jackson 5 Cover
stories.take: Year three of 'Give Your Gift' stacks three choirs on 'I'll Be There' — Gap is turning a holiday spot into a franchise.

stories.title: Raptors' Leonard completes knee treatment, begins 'return to play process'
stories.take: Kawhi has finished treatment for left knee swelling and started the return-to-play process in Toronto — no date yet, but the clock is finally running.

stories.title: Doncic has 2nd technical of the season rescinded by NBA
stories.take: The league wiped the technical Luka picked up late in the second quarter of Monday's 138-117 win over Miami.

stories.title: Draymond ejected after scuffle with Brooks, Suns; Curry says it 'lit a fire' in Warriors
stories.take: Two technicals in one sequence — Draymond's first ejection of the season and the 31st of his career — and Curry says it fired the Warriors up.

stories.title: Missing 11 players, Pacers play just six in loss to Hawks
stories.take: Eleven players sidelined, six logging every meaningful minute, and still only a 108-104 loss to Atlanta — a skeleton-crew effort.

stories.title: Ty Jerome is on a Linsanity-esque run, but here's why his MVP-level scoring isn't that big of a surprise
stories.take: The Grizzlies guard has been a per-minute monster since his Cleveland breakout — the run looks sudden only if you weren't watching the minutes.

stories.title: Dumonts now controlling owners of Mavs with nearly 70% share
stories.take: The Dumont family bought out Miriam Adelson's shares last month and now controls nearly 70% of the Mavericks.

stories.title: MLB proposes delaying salary cap until 2028 season
stories.take: With the CBA expiring Dec. 1, the league offers to phase the rest of its labor deal in for 2027 and push the cap to 2028 — a smoother ramp, same fight.

stories.title: Mariners hire Kanzler as manager to replace fired Wilson
stories.take: Seattle picked the Cubs' farm director Jason Kanzler — 36, no managerial experience, and the second-youngest manager in baseball.

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong, Jacob Misiorowski, more named finalists for MVP, Cy Young and Rookie of the Year awards
stories.take: Four members of the champion Brewers are finalists for the big BBWAA awards, with ace Jacob Misiorowski leading the club's haul.

stories.title: Bednar, Suzuki, Arozarena among eight players to receive qualifying offers
stories.take: Eight players got the $23.15M qualifying offer — they have until Nov. 17 to accept or test the market.

stories.title: MLB rumors: How Yankees could make a Tarik Skubal deal work, plus Mets' priority and a Rangers pivot
stories.take: Free agency is open and the hot stove leads with Skubal: how the Yankees could actually build a deal for the ace everyone wants.

stories.title: Democrats poised to flip House in midterm elections after two turbulent years of Trump
stories.take: Democrats are on course to take the House despite aggressive Republican redistricting — the night's headline result.

stories.title: Democrats on path to retake Senate from Republicans after historic wins
stories.take: Annie Andrews wins in South Carolina and Roy Cooper in North Carolina — the Senate map broke the Democrats' way in states that were not supposed to be close.

stories.title: Democrat James Talarico wins Texas Senate seat
stories.take: Per the AP call, Talarico beats Ken Paxton — a Democrat winning statewide in Texas, the result that defines the wave.

stories.title: Amy Acton wins Ohio race for governor, ending 16 years of Republican control of office
stories.take: The Democratic doctor beats Trump-endorsed Vivek Ramaswamy and becomes Ohio's first woman governor.

stories.title: Deb Haaland wins in New Mexico and will become first female Native American governor
stories.take: The former interior secretary defeats Republican Gregg Hull — a first for a Native American woman in a governor's office.

stories.title: Ukraine war briefing: race to free dozens trapped under rubble of Russian strikes on aid hub
stories.take: Zelenskyy says 33 were killed and more than 50 may be trapped in Komyshuvakha as Russia hammers Ukraine's energy grid on day 1,715 of the war.

stories.title: Governor-elect Becerra must quickly confront state budget mess Newsom left behind
stories.take: Xavier Becerra won the governor's race — and inherits a budget problem he has to answer with a spending plan days after his January inauguration.

stories.title: California accepts big broadband money from Trump — but not the terms and conditions
stories.take: The state took $1.4B in federal broadband funding while refusing to drop the net neutrality laws the program forbids — a fight Sacramento calls 'preposterous' to avoid.

stories.title: 14 propositions are on the California ballot. Voters are deciding on taxes, healthcare and more
stories.take: A billionaire tax, voter ID, recall changes and a bid to speed building by limiting environmental reviews — the prop slate is as consequential as the races.

stories.title: Feds deploy election monitors to L.A. as 9th Circuit sides with Trump in ballot dispute
stories.take: DOJ's 1,000-monitor deployment — its largest ever — includes Los Angeles, and nearly two-thirds of California voters feared the feds might try to stop the count.

stories.title: Trash truck engulfed in flames on 5 Freeway, causing lane closures, traffic nightmare
stories.take: A burning trash truck shut lanes on the southbound 5 in the San Fernando Valley on Tuesday afternoon — election-day traffic made worse.

stories.title: Yet another rare sea turtle nest discovered in Southern California, this time in Ventura
stories.take: An olive ridley nest in Ventura is only the third ever documented on the West Coast — warming water keeps rewriting the map.

stories.title: How we know when someone wins an election
stories.take: The AP declares a winner only when certain the trailing candidate cannot catch up — based on the actual vote count, not a projection • About 5,000 reporting units feed returns to roughly 5,000 election-night staff, the biggest single-story effort in journalism • AP VP David Scott's standard: 'accuracy at 100 and speed at zero' if forced to choose • AP will call about 7,000 races this cycle; of ~12,000 calls earlier this year, 4 were wrong

stories.title: Will data centers rock the vote?
stories.take: Mostly no — these are not 'the data center elections'; voters rank the economy and Iran higher • But backlash is nationwide: across party lines, voters say they don't want data centers in their communities, and almost no politician defends them outright • A Democratic sweep likely means more local moratoriums and rules that data centers pay their own power bills — not a national ban • Bellwether: Florida, where Byron Donalds has been branded 'Data Center Donalds'

stories.title: Was populism worth it?
stories.take: No durable payoff after 10 years — Jonathan Chait says populism knocked the old Republican elite off its peg but entrenched the economic elite instead of displacing it • Its broadest policy, the tariffs, was done by executive action alone, never through Congress, so Democrats can reverse it in office • Chait's verdict: the moment ends when people see the agenda doesn't benefit them — timing uncertain • Eric Levitz's media theory: populism blooms when gatekeepers can't filter the conversation, from radio to social media

stories.title: Disney Plans Thousands of Layoffs, Targeting 20% Cost Savings
stories.take: Disney is targeting a 20% cut in annual costs — roughly 2,000 jobs cut April–September and possibly 2,000 more, for at least $1B in run-rate savings • Parks are untouched; cuts hit TV and some ESPN, funding streaming and the $60B, 10-year parks plan • The point is 2027: double-digit EPS growth promised after ~16% this year • Apple segment: $28B free cash flow, but AI-driven memory prices squeeze margins for the next 12 months

stories.title: AI Lurches Toward Recursive Self-Improvement
stories.take: Recursive self-improvement is the through-line: Sundar Pichai credits AI with accelerating Alphabet's own training and launch velocity • MIT paper: GPT-6 Astra edited just 0.016% of a small model's weights and lifted its math scores 6x — caveat, the edited models are tiny next to frontier systems • Anthropic updated its safety doc: internal estimates say it may imminently cross its RSI danger threshold • Musk called Grokbot's serving costs 'unsustainably high relative to revenue' as users hit new limits — the subsidy-era fight in one quote

stories.title: GTA 6 Is HOW MANY Gigabytes?! - Kinda Funny Games Daily 11.03.26
stories.take: 212 gigabytes — Rockstar's official preload size for GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series, with preload starting November 10 • Elder Scrolls 6 is officially titled 'Sentinel,' pointing at Hammerfell • Nintendo's Ocarina of Time remake fixes the Water Temple — Aonuma calls it 'overdue homework' from 28 years ago • itch.io deleted a couple of terabytes of AI slop and added a 'no AI' search filter

stories.title: As Midterm Election Results Roll In, These Are the Races to Watch
stories.take: The races to watch: Kentucky's 6th (Dembo vs. Alvarado in a Trump+15 seat), Indiana's Spartz race, the NY-metro Lawler and Kean defenses, and Iowa — 'Iowa can tell you pretty much everything about this election cycle' • House math: Democrats need a net three seats; Schumer calls the mood 'nauseously optimistic' • Trump says U.S. military aid to Israel ends this year — a phase-out Netanyahu expected over a decade • Markets: S&P +0.4%, Nasdaq +0.8%, Dow −0.4%, its worst midterm Election Day since 1990

stories.title: When it comes to the job market, love the one you're with
stories.take: Love the one you're with: hiring is at 2012–13 levels, so EPI's advice is to hang on to your job — September quits ticked up to 3.4M, but nothing else says it's safe to move • Productivity is strong (fast GDP, flat hours) yet wages lag inflation, and low churn may be part of why • Health care, the sector that carried job growth for two years, is cooling — hires down ~13% year on year • Pet food is a ~$70B business: Royal Canin taste-tests with 377 dogs and cats in the south of France

stories.title: Voters weigh in on this election, Election monitors at CA polls, Waymo expands to South Bay — Evening Edition
stories.take: DOJ is sending about 1,000 election monitors to all 50 states — its largest effort ever — including LA, Alameda, Sacramento and San Diego counties; AG Bonta is deploying state watchers to watch them • Experts warn of a California 'red mirage': Republicans vote earlier and counting is slow, so late Democratic shifts are normal, not interference • Waymo now serves much of the South Bay and South LA, with DMV testing approval from Ventura County to the border • Altadena fire survivors turned their interviews into a play about healing

stories.title: More coastal flooding likely this winter for SoCal coasts, Neighbors protecting Boyle Heights voters, LA rams welcome back Myles Garret— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: Last week's record tides — gauges in San Pedro, La Jolla and Santa Barbara broke all-time records — are a preview: El Niño Kelvin waves plus an ocean heatwave mean worse flooding when king tides peak in December and January • Boyle Heights has 60+ trained neighborhood vote protectors watching vote centers after ICE sightings near a polling place • Rams star Myles Garrett returns to practice after mid-September knee surgery; McVay gave no game timeline for the 4–4 Rams

stories.title: What races to watch as experts predict a midterm 'blue wave'
stories.take: The bellwethers: Kentucky's 6th and Indiana's Spartz race (both read by 3 p.m. PT), then Texas — likely known by bedtime; Democrats need four Senate flips, with North Carolina and Ohio breaking their way and Maine/Alaska ranked-choice races possibly taking weeks • Florida governor is the sleeper: Jolly within the margin of error against Donalds • Mother Jones' Ari Berman: voting itself went smoothly — the interference risk is after Election Day, in counting and certification • LA's mayor's race won't be final for days: last time, +10 points still took eight days
